name: TheEightyEightBham
street: 2012 Magnolia Ave S suite R5 & R6
description: Eighty Eight is a vibrant Birmingham venue renowned for its live music and grown, sexy atmosphere. The venue offers a sophisticated setting with a great sound system, a diverse song selection, and excellent entertainment including live bands and piano performances. It features both open mic nights and private event options, making it a popular spot for adults seeking a classy, musical experience with quality drinks and attentive service. Parking is limited, and reservations are recommended for special events.
